KAKAROTMOD-GRAVITY_PANEL.title: Gravity Training
KAKAROTMOD-GRAVITY_PANEL.off:
Enemies get stronger, and Kakarot earns training rewards in return. Higher gravity unlocks more rewards.
[color=#948c78]Singleplayer, new runs only. Stacks with Ascension.[/color]
KAKAROTMOD-GRAVITY_PANEL.reward1: First Attack you play each combat: +1 Rage
KAKAROTMOD-GRAVITY_PANEL.reward2: Win a combat: +1 Max HP, +2 for Elites and Bosses
KAKAROTMOD-GRAVITY_PANEL.reward3: Rest Sites offer [gold]Train[/gold]: heal 10% HP and start every later combat with +1 Strength. Stacks
KAKAROTMOD-GRAVITY_PANEL.weights: [gold]Drop your weights[/gold]: right-click the relic in combat, once per combat. +5 Dexterity this turn, but no Max HP from that combat.
KAKAROTMOD-GRAVITY_PANEL.weightsNoCost: [gold]Drop your weights[/gold]: right-click the relic in combat, once per combat. +5 Dexterity this turn.
KAKAROTMOD-GRAVITY_PANEL.note: Singleplayer, new runs only. Stacks with Ascension.
